name: llm-commit
description: Generate Git commit messages using LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI and Custom OpenAI-compatible APIs.

enumDescriptions: Custom configuration using manual URL and API key
llm-commit.provider.description: Select a provider preset or use custom configuration.

llm-commit.apiUrl.description: URL of the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.

llm-commit.apiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible API (if required).
llm-commit.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use LLM Commit: Set API Key to store a credential for an explicitly authorized provider and API origin. This legacy setting is never sent directly.

llm-commit.model.description: Provider-to-model overrides (lm-studio, ollama, openai, custom). An empty object uses provider defaults. A legacy string explicitly overrides all HTTP providers.

llm-commit.prompt.default:
Generate a git commit message following the Conventional Commits specification for the changes below.

**Format:** <type>(<optional scope>): <description>

**Types:**
- feat: A new feature
- fix: A bug fix
- docs: Documentation changes
- style: Code style changes (formatting, whitespace, no logic change)
- refactor: Code restructuring without changing behavior
- perf: Performance improvements
- test: Adding or updating tests
- build: Build system or dependency changes
- ci: CI/CD configuration changes
- chore: Routine tasks, maintenance

**Rules:**
- Use imperative, present tense (e.g., "add" not "added")
- Keep the description under 50 characters
- Lowercase the description (no capital start, no period)
- Add scope in parentheses if applicable (e.g., `feat(auth):`)
- For breaking changes, add `!` before colon (e.g., `feat!:`)

**Diff:**
```diff
{diff}
```

**Commit message:**
llm-commit.prompt.description: Prompt template for the LLM. Use '{diff}' as placeholder for the git diff.
llm-commit.prompt.patternErrorMessage: Include at least one {diff} placeholder; every placeholder receives the literal diff.

llm-commit.maxDiffLength.description: Maximum diff length in Unicode code points (1–100000). Longer diffs are truncated before prompt insertion.

llm-commit.timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP transport and response-body timeout in seconds (1–600), starting after authorization. Repository selection and consent do not consume this timeout.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint

untrustedWorkspaces.description: HTTP generation and API key management require a trusted workspace.
